# Proposal: a digital visitor log for the head office

To: Kitahama Trading, facilities team
Date: 20 October 2026

## The current process

Visitors at your head office write their name, company, and host in a paper book. On busy mornings a queue forms at the desk. Reaching the host by phone can take 5 minutes.

The paper book is also hard to search. Finding last month's visitors means turning the pages one by one. The book sits open on the desk, where anyone can read the names in it.

## What we propose

We propose one tablet at the reception desk, where visitors type their own name and host. The host gets a message on their laptop and phone as soon as the visitor finishes. The server encrypts the log and deletes it after 3 months.

Hosts can register expected visitors in advance. Each visitor will get a printed badge with the name of their host. An expected visitor only needs to scan the code in their invitation. Reception staff see the queue on the same screen. Reception staff should check the badge list at the end of each day.

## How we would roll it out

The paper book and the tablet run side by side for the first month. Our team will meet the reception staff each week during that month to adjust the wording on the screen. From the second month, the tablet replaces the book.

Your IT team must agree on where messages go and how long the server keeps the log before the rollout. We recommend a short workshop for this.
